model.name: Gates must not encode a SNAPSHOT of the product's shape — a snapshot rots when the product changes (symbol-anchor / current-contract fixtures / load-checked-and-run, each stub-must-fail)
model.description: UNIFYING CAUSE: a gate that encodes a SNAPSHOT of the product's shape ROTS whenever the product changes — the gate goes RED (or, worse, silently un-verifying) while the FEATURE is GREEN. Evidence-backed by 5 measured instances across 4 mechanisms (tester, 2026-08-12): (1) UN-LOADABLE import — rc7 threw SyntaxError from a removed import, verified NOTHING, yet its Test read status:pass until a manual audit; (2) synthetic fixture vs a HARDENED contract — rc3 fed a synthetic single-Active sprint, then resolveSprintPin was hardened fail-closed unless the sprint resolves to a real on-disk dir, so the fake stopped qualifying (product got stricter, test became wrong); (3) LINE-PIN drift — r408 hardcoded server.ts slice(1439,1446) and R40.22 churn moved those lines; (4) delegation-contract change — r4010's src-audit asserted the OLD direct-Done write, but OUR OWN C4.3 commit made approveByOwner delegate to statusNext; (5) synthetic fixture vs a CHURNED contract — r309, same class as (2), backing FOUR rows. Fix by-construction (kill the snapshot-encoding generator, NOT repeat the gate-repair — same shape as R37.15/R37.16). ★ SUB-MECHANISM (tester, worth naming): ABSOLUTE-COUNT-OF-A-TRANSIENT-POPULATION rot — rc7 hardcoded 'S18 --prove names ~98 gaps'; the board is now ~0 because WE COMPLETED the work, so the gate went RED reading PROGRESS as REGRESSION. It encodes a snapshot of our FAILURE. Sibling to the synthetic-vs-hardened-contract class (rc3) but DISTINCT: rc3 = the contract tightened; this = the measured DEFECT POPULATION shrank. rc7 alone = FOUR rots in one file (return-shape string[]->BoardDiff.gaps / obsolete ID format R-C99 vs R<n>.<n> / absolute-count-vs-improved-state / zero-loss drift) — the canonical multi-rot example. ★★ STRENGTHENED FRAMING (tester, 6 sub-mechanisms measured): snapshot-gates rot FASTEST WHEN WE DO GOOD WORK — 4 OF 6 rots were caused by US IMPROVING the product, not by decay. ★ MEASURE-CORRECTION of rc3: its ASSUMED cause was dir-resolution (WRONG); the REAL cause is OUR OWN ERA-BOUNDARY change — we built the frozen-legacy exclusion (resolveSprintPin drops sprints <= FROZEN_LEGACY_MAX=18 from the pin universe, R-C1 refinement), which silently made rc3's synthetic sprint-2 an INVALID fixture. A gate that snapshots the product's shape is punished precisely BY progress: churn, hardening, contract changes, era boundaries, and our own SUCCESS all move the shape the gate froze.

model.crossRefNote: Honesty family (the gate/board must not lie, by construction): R37.13 (no bespoke-scheme ids) + R37.15 (no embedded-derived-field names) + R37.16 (no sibling-credited RIPE) + R37.17 (no snapshot-rot gates) + R40.32 (gates self-assert served==committed). Distinct-intent each; R37.17 unifies the 3 gate-authoring guards under ONE cause (snapshot-rot) — its 3 ACs are facets of that one intent, not separate subsystems (contrast R37.4 C4 which genuinely split).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Gates SYMBOL-ANCHOR only — slice a NAMED fn body / anchor on a declaration — NEVER a line-range slice or hardcoded line number. LINT-ENFORCED: a line-pin in gate code -> RED (r408's server.ts slice(1439,1446) is the offender; r4010's fix already dogfoods symbol-anchoring). STUB-MUST-FAIL: plant a line-pin in a gate -> the lint goes RED, else it certifies nothing.

Fixtures must satisfy the product's CURRENT contract; PREFER REAL artifacts over synthetic. A synthetic fixture that no longer qualifies under a hardened/churned contract (rc3 synthetic single-Active sprint vs resolveSprintPin real-dir fail-closed; r309 same class) is a STALE GATE, not a broken product — the gate must not read pass on a fixture the current product would reject. Where synthetic is unavoidable it MUST be constructed to satisfy the current contract. STUB-MUST-FAIL: feed a fixture that violates the current contract -> the gate catches it (does not silently pass). [rc3 REAL cause corrected: not dir-resolution but OUR era-boundary change (frozen-legacy FROZEN_LEGACY_MAX=18) invalidating the synthetic sprint-2 — a fixture must satisfy the CURRENT scope/era universe, not a past one.]

NEVER assert an ABSOLUTE COUNT of a TRANSIENT population (e.g. 'there are 98 gaps') — a count of something we are actively shrinking treats SUCCESS as regression. Instead assert an ID-SET + a DOWN-ONLY RATCHET: these specific IDs must not GROW, and any that CLOSE stay closed. That survives our own progress; an absolute count cannot. (rc7 hardcoded ~98 S18 gaps -> ~0 after completion -> false RED.) The sharpest form of the fixtures-current-contract guard. STUB-MUST-FAIL: shrink the population (close a tracked ID) -> the gate must STAY GREEN (progress != regression); GROW it (a new/reopened ID) -> RED.

★ EVERY gate is LOAD-CHECKED and RUN so an un-loadable or never-run gate CANNOT sit marked-pass — the structural fix for the ENTIRE stale-pass class (rc7: SyntaxError from a removed import verified NOTHING while its Test read status:pass until a manual audit). STUB-MUST-FAIL: plant an un-loadable gate (bad import/syntax) OR a never-run gate -> the load/run check goes RED and its Test cannot read pass.

Each guard AC carries a STUB-MUST-FAIL arm or it certifies nothing (a guard that cannot fail proves nothing) — the meta-bite discipline shared with R37.13/R37.15/R37.16 + R37.3's gate-proves-the-gate-prover.

EVIDENCE-BACKED by 6 measured rot sub-mechanisms (see rotTaxonomy): (1) line-pin churn [r408] / (2->4) rc3 ASSUMED hardening but REAL cause = our era-boundary frozen-legacy exclusion / (3) our C4.3 delegation contract change [r4010] / (5) our SUCCESS closed the gaps a gate counted [rc7 98->0] / (6) API rename+removed export [rc7]. ★ 4 OF 6 were caused by US IMPROVING the product => snapshot-gates rot FASTEST when we do good work — a demonstrated cause, not a speculative one, and the reason the guard is worth building.
